overview: Marus Seru is a vast stone plateau fractured by geomantic instability. Crystal formations and stone creatures dominate the landscape.
history: Once a stable mesa, Marus Seru fractured during ancient geomantic upheavals. Seru frontier patrols now monitor the region for threats.
hooks: Stone creatures migrate toward the Seru frontier.
A Seru patrol goes missing near the cracked plain.
A massive geode formation begins to hum with arcane energy.
